inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Used Only for Infant that Cannot Stand or Can Stand Without Hitting Head: During the inspection an infant was observed in the bottom of a stacking crib standing with their head touching the bottom of the top crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Used Only for Infant that Cannot Stand or Can Stand Without Hitting Head (26 TAC §746.2413(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: The operation did not have transportation consent to bring a child from and to school in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The operation stated they did not bring the emergency transport and treatment authorizations when transporting children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection a classroom with a specified age of 5 years old had one teacher to 26 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Potty-Chairs: During the inspection a potty chair was observed with urine still inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Potty-Chairs (26 TAC §746.3407(5))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: During the inspection it was determined the operation had not completed a fire drill in the past 2 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: The record for the most recent CPSC report was not available during this insepction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: During review it was determined the operation was not documenting their emergency drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence: During the inspection an advertisement was seen playing on a screen with children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During the inspection screen time was observed while children were eating their afternoon snacks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The wrong number of children inside a classroom was given by a caregiver during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children did not wash their hands before eating their snack after nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children: During the inspection a 4 month old was being cared for in a room with a 4 year old child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.2403(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: During the inspection 2 children that did not have admission information on file were being cared for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: During the inspection a portable heater was observed turned on and sitting on the floor next to a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The wrong number of children was given by a caregiver in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence: While putting on a music on YouTube for nap an advertisement played in two rooms while children were present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Two children were observed going to the restroom, but not washing their hands afterwards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Screen time was being used at arrival with a 13 month old present in the room watching.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Only 4 fire drills were noted to have been complete in 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left alone inside a classroom while the other children and caregivers were on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The wrong number of children were stated present in the classroom until it was mentioned to the caregvier.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children: A 13  month old infant was present in a classroom with the oldest indiviual 42 months older than them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.2403(3))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: A bottle of Lysol disinfectant spray was seen sitting on a cabinet within children's reach inside the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was observed wandering into the daycare office. Staff was unaware the child had done so.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: During the inspection a bundle of bananas were observed in the food pantry to have mold on them.     This was corrected at the inspection when the bananas were thrown away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the inspection the caregivers did not know how many children they were in charge of and had to recount multiple times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the inspection paint was observed peeling from the baseboards and wall exposing some drywall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The nap cots were observed during the visit and were not labeled to indicate whose cot was whose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: A tracking system for children was not available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Used diapers were seen in a trash can within reach of children in one of the bathrooms the children use. Children were seen using the bathroom.    This was corrected at inspection when the trash can was removed from the bathroom by the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: A container of bleach wipes and baby wipes were observed in reach of children inside rooms where child care took place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: An infant was observed in a restrictive device for more than 15 minutes during the inspection. The infant was not being fed or transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Used diapers were seen in a trash can with no lid within reach of children in one of the bathrooms the children use. Old food was also observed in a trash can within reach of children in a room where care took place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the inspection an infant was observed asleep in a restrictive device. The caregiver did not notice until it was mentioned to her.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection two caregivers with a pending background check were present and caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: During the inspection a 3 year old was observed in timeout for 5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number: During the inspection 4 children's records were reviewed and all 4 were missing the children's full address, the emergency contact address and 3 were missing the emergency contact phone number. 2 were missing the school's phone number, and 1 was missing the emergency facility or provider address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number (26 TAC §746.605(2))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During the inspection the person in charge did not know where the staff records were kept and could not get them to CCR staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities: During the inspection the children started centers before washing their hands after coming inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3417(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: During the inspection 3 staff records were observed and found to be missing the statement of center policies, statement of personnel policies, orientation statement, employment begin date, and the age/education/qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operational policies were reviewed and found to be missing the Emergency Preparedness Plan. Along with the Safe Sleep Policy, Requirement for Hearing and Vision Screenings, Parental Notification of policy changes, Transportation, Water Activities, Procedure to review most recent report and standards online, and how to contact local licensing office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))
